title: Keeping It Reel on 30A | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * Less than 1 Mile from Blue Mountain Beach Regional Beach Access* Covered Porch and Balcony* Four Bikes Included * Great Outdoor Space with Firepit* Community Pool * Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Red
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * Less than 1 Mile from Blue Mountain Beach Regional Beach Access* Covered Porch and Balcony* Four Bikes Included * Great Outdoor Space with Firepit* Community Pool * Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village * 2 miles to Gulf Place Town Center * Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Keeping It Reel on 30A is a lovely 3 bedroom, 3 1/2 bath beach house that is the perfect vacation getaway for your family and friends. You will love hanging in the backyard around the firepit or under the covered porch. The chef in your group will love the modern kitchen filled with ample storage space to put things for your group's next meal. There is ample seating in the dining area as well. On the first floor you will have a king guest bedroom with an en suite bathroom and the living room has a sleeper sofa. On the second floor, you will find the master king bedroom and a sleeper sofa with an en suite bathroom and a king guest bedroom with an en suite bathroom which makes this home sleep up to 10 comfortably. Join us not to embark on a journey of creating timeless beach memories that will be cherished for a lifetime at Keeping It Reel on 30A!Ventana Dunes is a charming village of Blue Mountain Beach, tucked between Highway 30A and hundreds of acres of State Forest. Ventana Dunes is convenient to the beach, shopping, and other hotspots while still being quiet and secluded. You will love the charming community pool and taking a stroll to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a delicious treat. This community is centrally located, making it easy driving distance to many locations including the neighboring communities of WaterColor and Seaside. The Bed Setup:1st FloorGuest Bedroom: King BedLiving Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King Bed and Queen Sleeper SofaGuest Bedroom: King BedAREA ATTRACTIONS: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1.5 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald, green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
